summary: MU PIN CONFIRMED, on the pages. MU's coverage string is per-adaptation and carries two segments — anime.start 'Vol 1, Chap 1 (S1) / Vol 9, Chap 77 (S2)', anime.end 'Vol 9, Chap 77 (S1) / Vol 14, Chap 120 Page 12 (S2)'. Our entry is S1 only (24 rows), so the governing segment is 'Vol 9, Chap 77 (S1)' and the stored pin took it correctly — no G37 leak. Two independent page-level sources agree that ep 24 'Advent' (2024-03-31) adapts ch 75 p.13-20, ch 76, and ch 77 p.1-7: nanatsu-no-taizai.fandom's episode-24 infobox chapter field (page-partitioned against ep 23's 75 p.1-13 and ep 25's 77 p.7-20) and programming-cafe's anicomi reverse index, whose 話数→アニメ話数 column splits ch 75 across 1-23/1-24 and ch 77 across 1-24/2-1. END = 77, START = 75, volume 9 (fandom's Volume 9 page and programming-cafe's 単行本 column both close vol 9 exactly on ch 77). A47 does not demote the END: ep 24's tail of ch 77 is 7 pages, above the 5-page scrap bar and carrying the finale's own climax (Arthur's advent / the King's Authority opening), and ep 24 is this entry's finale so the tail has no next-episode owner (C1). The one surprise is a 2-page out-of-order fragment — fandom's field also lists ch 80 p.14-15 (the distant characters reacting to Arthur) — which cannot move the END: it is out of running order (A4), it is re-adapted in full by S2 ep 25, and programming-cafe's reverse index does not carry it; it is delivered as a graft annotation, medium. The continue is C1 IN the straddled chapter: ch 77, vol 9 — S2 restarts there (MU's own S2 start segment is 'Vol 9, Chap 77'). S1 adapts ch 1 → 77 p.7 with no skipped CHAPTER.

A 2-page beat lifted forward out of running order — the distant characters (Pellegarde, Gowther, Howzer, Edlin, Dolchomonte) reacting to Arthur's advent, which in the manga sits inside ch 80 'King Arthur vs. Lancelot'. MEDIUM: only the fandom episode field carries it, its own Manga/Anime Differences section describes the same beat as an anime addition, and programming-cafe's reverse index assigns ch 80 solely to ep 25. The Melagaland battle is materially EXTENDED for the finale — anime-added exchanges (Meian no Ori, the stretching arms, Deadly Poison at Percival and Isolde, Isolde's mini-Percival bombs, Critical Over, Tristan's kill). These are elaborations of the source's own beats inside adapted chapters, not an original plot line, so the row stays canon under T28; no anime-original story share.
